G2759.strongs: a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse)

G2716.strongs: to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion
senses: κατ-εργάζομαι (emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, [[r:ROM.4.15|Rom 4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20]], [[r:2CO.7.10|2Co 7:10]], [[r:EPH.6.13|Eph 6:13]], [[r:JAS.1.3|Jas 1:3]]; pass., [[r:2CO.12.12|2Co 12:12]]; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:ROM.7.13|Rom 7:13]], [[r:2CO.4.17|2Co 4:17 7:11 9:11]]; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ROM.15.18|Rom 15:18]]; τ. σωτηρίαν, [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]]; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, [[r:2CO.5.5|2Co 5:5]] (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, [[r:ROM.1.27|Rom 1:27 2:9]], [[r:1CO.5.3|1Co 5:3]], [[r:1PE.4.3|1Pe 4:3]].† (AS)

G2744.strongs: to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense)
senses: to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on [[r:JAS.1.9|Jas 1:9]]): absol., [[r:1CO.1.31|1Co 1:31]] (LXX) [[r:1CO.4.7|1Co 4:7 13:3]], [[r:2CO.10.13|2Co 10:13 10:17]]" (LXX) [[r:2CO.11.16|2Co 11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6]], [[r:EPH.2.9|Eph 2:9]], [[r:JAS.4.16|Jas 4:16]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:2CO.9.2|2Co 9:2 11:30]]; before ἐν (LXX), [[r:ROM.2.23|Rom 2:23 5:3]], [[r:1CO.3.21|1Co 3:21]], [[r:2CO.5.12|2Co 5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9]], [[r:GAL.6.13|Gal 6:13-14]] [[r:JAS.1.9|Jas 1:9]]; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, [[r:ROM.2.17|Rom 2:17 5:11]]; ἐν κυρίῳ, [[r:1CO.1.31|1Co 1:31]] (LXX) [[r:2CO.10.17|2Co 10:17]] (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, [[r:PHP.3.3|Php 3:3]]; before ἐπί with dative, [[r:ROM.5.2|Rom 5:2]]; περί, with genitive, [[r:2CO.10.8|2Co 10:8]]; εἰς, [[r:2CO.10.16|2Co 10:16]]; ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), [[r:2CO.7.14|2Co 7:14 12:5]]; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[r:1CO.1.29|1Co 1:29]] (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).† (AS)

G2746.strongs: boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense
G2746.kjv: boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing
senses: (καυχάομαι), a boasting, glorying: [[r:ROM.3.27|Rom 3:27]], [[r:2CO.11.10|2Co 11:10 11:17]], [[r:JAS.4.16|Jas 4:16]]; before ὑπέρ, [[r:2CO.7.4|2Co 7:4 8:24]]; ἐτί, with genitive, [[r:2CO.7.14|2Co 7:14]]; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., [[r:ROM.15.17|Rom 15:17]]; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), [[r:1TH.2.19|1Th 2:19]]; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), [[r:2CO.1.12|2Co 1:12.]]† (AS)

senses: a boast (Pind.): [[r:2CO.5.12|2Co 5:12 9:3]] (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on [[r:GAL.6.4|Gal 6:4]]; Lft., Notes, 204, 277).

G2758.strongs: to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify
G2758.kjv: make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain
senses: (κενός, which see), to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, [[r:1CO.9.15|1Co 9:15]]; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, [[r:PHP.2.7|Php 2:7]] (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14]]; ὁ σταυρός, [[r:1CO.1.17|1Co 1:17]]; καύχημα, [[r:2CO.9.3|2Co 9:3]]† (AS)

κιθαρίζω to play upon the lyre or harp: [[r:1CO.14.7|1Co 14:7]], [[r:REV.14.2|Rev 14:2]].† (AS)

G2734.strongs: to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively)

(κάτω), lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. [[r:PSA.139.15|Psa 139:15]]; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): [[r:EPH.4.9|Eph 4:9.]]† (AS)
foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).

(κελεύω), a call, summons, shout of command: [[r:1TH.4.16|1Th 4:16]] (see M, Th., in l).† (AS)

G2757.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G2756]] and [[w:G5456]]

G2704.strongs: to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave;
senses: In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, [[r:2TI.3.8|2Ti 3:8.]]† (AS)

G2777.strongs: properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled)

(καῦσος, burning heat, fever), only in pass.,
In NT, to burn with great heat: [[r:2PE.3.10|2Pe 3:10 3:12]] (V. Mayor, in l).† (AS)
In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: [[r:REV.2.27|Rev 2:27.]]† (AS)

G2738.strongs: properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow

G2790.root: from [[w:G2788]] and a derivative of the same as [[w:G5603]]

G2767.root: prolonged form of a more primary κεράω (which is used in certain tenses)
G2767.strongs: to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking)
senses: κεράννυμι to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: [[r:REV.18.6|Rev 18:6]]; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, [[r:REV.14.10|Rev 14:10.]]† SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)
κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό (from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן) cinnamon: [[r:REV.18.13|Rev 18:13.]]† (AS)
